{{Top|leg}}
'''Brath bearings''' were used for steering [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], allowing smooth and fast turns without a loss of control. [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]] and [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]] speeder bikes utilized brath bearings.
